title: Cost Estimate
description: Formalized output of the historical lookup estimator. This is an observation capability — it answers 'what is a reasonable planning range based on previous executions?' not 'what will definitely happen.' Method starts as historical_lookup. If this changes, the schema should version.

method.description: Estimation method. Starts as historical_lookup. If this changes, the schema should version.

job_class.description: Class of work being estimated (e.g. 'implementation_task', 'refactor', 'diagnostic'). Derived from work_type input or inferred from project context.

sample_count.description: Number of historical sessions matching this job class. Drives confidence. Maps to Dead Reckoning's CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLDS: high>=20, medium>=8, low>=3, wayward<3.

p50.description: Median token cost for this job class.

p80.description: 80th percentile — reasonable upper bound for planning.

percentiles.description: Token cost percentiles from historical data. Maps directly to Dead Reckoning's PercentileResult.

confidence.description: Confidence level based on sample count. high>=20, medium>=8, low>=3, wayward<3.

match_scope.description: How tightly the estimate matches the target context. Narrower scope = more relevant.

baseline_source.description: Where the baseline data came from (calibrated, configured, etc.).

generated_at.description: When this estimate was generated. Estimates go stale.
